newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cycle & Carriage says outlook challenging.
newsitem.headline: Cycle & Carriage says outlook challenging.

text.p: Car retailer Cycle & Carriage Ltd said on Wednesday the outlook for 1997 remained challenging.
Cycle & Carriage said in a statement issued with its 1996 results that the group saw more modest growth last year than in previous years.

"We have maintained our share of the passenger car market in Singapore in a very competitive environment. The outlook remains challenging as we do not expect to see any let up in competition in the near future," it said.

"1997 is expected to continue to be a difficult year for the group's Singapore motor operations, with the size of the passenger car market likely to decline by about five percent against 1996, and increasing pressure being felt on margins."
"The weak performance of the property operation (in 1996) was due to certain construction delays. We would expect to see significant growth in our property earnings in 1997."
